objects.text: Operations Analyst with 8+ years of experience in operational analysis, process improvement, KPI reporting, workflow optimization, data analysis, documentation, and cross-functional operations. • Developed operational reporting tools and dashboards improving data accuracy and enabling root cause analysis.
• Coordinated operational reporting for multiple software releases, enabling timely insights and process refinements.
• Streamlined operational workflows, resulting in a 15% reduction in processing time.
• Coordinated with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure accurate documentation and seamless operational execution.
• Coordinated operational processes ensuring project milestones were met consistently on time.
• Maintained operational documentation and quality assurance for internal process flows.
• Assisted in operational system upgrades, contributing to improved efficiency and reporting accuracy.
